title.narrative: Unlocking pathways to support implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan

description.narrative: The project's objective of unlocking pathways to support the implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan directly contributes to several of these SDGs, such as SDG 7 (affordable and clean energy) and SDG 13 (climate action). The project aims to strengthen sustainability, integrate economic policies with environmental agendas, and enhance capacity building and research efforts in Pakistan, all of which are aligned with the SDGs prioritized by Denmark's development cooperation strategy. Therefore, the project's objectives are relevant in a global and national context and compatible with the strategic focus of SDGs prioritized in Denmark's current strategy for development cooperation and humanitarian action 'The World 2030'.

title.narrative: The discourse of carbon markets is expedited at both federal and provincial level by conducting capacity building and training of all relevant stakeholders across the carbon value chain of Pakistan.

- Inception meeting and high-level policy dialogue is conducted on "Unlocking pathways for effective implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan" -A 2-day training workshop (with denmark expert) is held on "Prospects of implementing carbon markets in Pakistan: Opportunities and Mechanisms" is conducted with representatives from MOFA, FBR, bureaucrats, legislators, parliamentarians & private sector trainers. -Training workshop with private sector is held on i)implementation of carbon markets through circularity in built environment, ii) implementation of carbon markets to foster economic agenda of environment friendly projects. -A 2-day training workshop is held on "Prospect of implementing carbon markets in Pakistan: Opportunities and Mechanisms" with provincial and local governments. -Policy Dialogue and launch event of research findings is conducted at the Flagship Annual Sustainable Development Conference (SDC) of SPI in December 2023.

title.narrative: The current knowledge gap in implementation framework of carbon is reduced by conducting a research study on "Unlocking pathways to support implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan"

Indicator 1: The research report on "unlocking pathways to support implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan" is developed and its findings disseminated to the relevant stakeholders at both federal and provincial level.
Indicator 2: The report will cover the identified knowledge gaps, its implementation framework and institutional scoping.
